title: Pending a Prior Authorization Request for Clinical Information
content:
**Operations clause.** A Prairie Ridge Health Plan Prior Authorization request may be pended for clinical information at most the class's pend limit, counted as the requests for information sent on the authorization over the life of the request. The provider has the class's response period in days to answer, and pending never extends the decision deadline beyond the one extension allowed. Without an answer by the response deadline the request is decided on the record as it stands, and a denial for that reason uses the denial reason "insufficient information".

The class settings this clause reads are the class's pend limit and response period.

## The clause in condition-and-result form

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Requests for information already sent on the request are fewer than the class's pend limit | the request may be pended again |
| Requests for information already sent equal the class's pend limit | the request is not pended again |
| The provider answers within the response period | review resumes |
| No answer by the response deadline | the request is decided on the record as it stands; a denial for that reason uses "insufficient information" |

## Basis questions

**Does a pend give the plan extra time to decide?** No. Pending never extends the decision deadline beyond the one extension allowed.

**Hypothetical case.** In a hypothetical class with a pend limit of 1 and a 10-day response period, a request pended once whose provider has not answered by the tenth day is decided on the record as it stands; if it is denied for that reason, the denial reason is "insufficient information".
